Subject: NYPD Museum Gala, May 9, 2012, Mandarin Hotel

 Dear Friend..                                      May 2012

 It seems every day we read of a New York City police officer killed or wounded in the line of
 duty. The very least we can do is support the museum which honors those who have sacrificed
 their life protecting us.
 I hope you will consider joining us as we honor the police heroes of New York City.
 I will take a number of prime tables and if you are able to purchase a table or a few seats we can
 all sit together.
 We also have great entertainment lined up and five former Commissioners will be present. Plus
 Commissioner Ray Kelly will give the keynote speech and possibly address any future political
 plans he may have.
 Hope to hear from you.

 John Catsimatidis
 jacny@aol.com
